description: TTL is opt-in per `job-lifecycle.md` §TTL and auto-reap: a job submitted with `--ttl 1` and then claimed becomes abandoned once real time passes its expiry, and the reap that runs at the start of every `sm jobs claim` fails it with reason `abandoned`. The staged sleep is 3x the armed TTL so the case is timing-safe, and the second claim exits 1 because the reap leaves the queue empty. The reap is asserted through its EFFECT (the abandoned row in `sm jobs list --json`) rather than any message, since the claim-side reap is silent by contract.
